known_gaps.detail: The checked-in schema has no non-owner role allowed to advance authority epochs or revoke memberships. The suite creates a temporary NOSUPERUSER NOBYPASSRLS NOINHERIT role with fixture-prefix-restricted SECURITY DEFINER helpers, then drops it.
known_gaps.name: no_persistent_governance_writer_boundary_in_research_schema

known_gaps.detail: The schema permits a release status update without a matching release event. The test actor writes both in one transaction, but the database does not force every caller to do so.
known_gaps.name: release_status_and_event_are_not_database_coupled

known_gaps.detail: An exposure inserted before withdrawal but committed after withdrawal remains status=active in storage. RLS hides it from runtime reads because the parent release is inactive.
known_gaps.name: active_exposure_metadata_survives_withdrawal

known_gaps.detail: A REPEATABLE READ transaction retains the authority row snapshot after a committed epoch advance; old-epoch reads remain visible until the transaction ends.
known_gaps.name: repeatable_read_epoch_snapshot_stays_authorized

known_gaps.detail: A REPEATABLE READ transaction retains team membership visibility after a committed membership revocation.
known_gaps.name: repeatable_read_membership_snapshot_stays_authorized

known_gaps.detail: A REPEATABLE READ transaction retains an authorized trajectory snapshot after a committed hard deletion.
known_gaps.name: repeatable_read_deleted_trajectory_stays_visible

races.name: concurrent_promotion
schedule: A inserts active release and blocks on advisory barrier
B attempts same-candidate active release and waits on transactionid

races.name: withdraw_then_promote
schedule: A marks current release withdrawn and blocks before commit
C promotion waits on the partial unique-index transaction
C commits as the sole active release
